# Landing pages

The job is to introduce something, make its value and identity intelligible, and support the next action. Product clarity and expressive art direction can coexist. Select a visual language for this product and audience rather than defaulting to the same neutral SaaS layout every time.

These are curated taste references, not performance rankings. The annotations are the aspects to borrow, not claims about a site's current implementation.

## Approved calibration pair

| Reference | What to study and borrow |
|---|---|
| [Family](https://family.co/) | An iOS crypto wallet: enlarged status controls and Send/Receive/Swap phone demos make the product tangible. Study the Send demo's tap feedback and changing states; let product behavior carry personality. |
| [Paper](https://paper.design/) | A connected design canvas: editor chrome, selection handles and terminal-to-playlist demonstrations make the tool and its output the visual subject. Borrow ambition tied to what people make, rather than unrelated decoration. |

## Established references

| Reference | What to study and borrow |
|---|---|
| [Linear](https://linear.app/) | Product-development software: study headline-to-demo scale, finely separated issue and agent panels, and aligned logo/figure rows. Cross-category craft anchor for hierarchy and restraint, not a mandatory dark palette or layout. |
| [Attio](https://attio.com/) | A CRM: job-based navigation, company tables with score pills and owner avatars, and email/qualification overlays turn actual product information into visual identity. |
| [Clay](https://www.clay.com/) | Go-to-market data and workflows: a tactile funnel-and-pipeline landscape leads into stacked, color-coded Data/Agents panels. A recurring conveyor metaphor sits beside concrete product explanations; personality does not replace clarity. |
| [Spline](https://spline.design/) | A 3D design platform: dimensional objects surround the creation prompt, followed by community examples of games, product mockups, characters and logos. Study rich interaction as a demonstration of the medium the product creates. |
| [Arc](https://arc.net/) | Browser product communication: grainy blue fields, scalloped section edges and warm gradients frame a large browser-window demonstration. Study color and character that surround a recognizable product, rather than substituting for it. |

## Spectacle boundary

[Active Theory](https://activetheory.net/) is an experiential studio site: a full-screen dark scene of luminous particles and dimensional forms surrounds sparse Work/Contact navigation. Its immersive craft is admired, not the normal landing-page intensity target. Borrow its ambition when immersion or emotional impact is part of the job; preserve a clear explanation and route to the product.

## Reserve

[Framer](https://www.framer.com/) presents a design platform through an oversized headline, paired primary/secondary actions and a wide framed product demonstration. [Resend](https://resend.com/) presents email tooling with a large serif headline, a dimensional cube and a quiet route to documentation.

Both were liked, but were not the strongest final selections. Borrow a relevant detail without displacing the approved calibration pair or narrowing every new design to the same software-marketing aesthetic.
